reviews.author: ABHIK MISRA
reviews.title: Poor Quality of Chain
reviews.body: Got the dispute order. There is no lock of the chain. You should check properly before sending. Also, The colour of the chain is already fading, I'm using it only 3 days. Don't buy at all.

sections.heading: How to Place?
sections.text:
Wear the Richie Rich Rice Chain Bracelet on your wrist as a daily crystal energy jewellery piece.
Before wearing, hold the bracelet for a few seconds and set an intention for wealth, protection, confidence, grounding, and success.
Secure the bracelet properly using the lobster lock closure for a safe and comfortable fit.
Style it with casual outfits, office looks, festive wear, party outfits, or stack it with other bracelets for a bold wrist look.
Avoid direct contact with water, perfume, sweat, and harsh chemicals to maintain the gold-toned shine and crystal quality.
After use, wipe gently with a soft dry cloth and store separately in a pouch or jewellery box.

 Product Description
 
 

 
 
 

 

 

 
 
 Elevate your everyday style with the Richie Rich Beaded Rice 24K Gold-Toned Chain Bracelet—a luxurious blend of timeless craftsmanship and meaningful crystal accents. Featuring a premium 24K gold-toned rice chain adorned with Pyrite and Black Obsidian beads, this bracelet is designed for those who appreciate bold elegance with a touch of symbolism.

Perfect for daily wear or special occasions, this statement piece effortlessly complements both casual and formal looks.

✨ Crystal Highlights

• 🖤 Black Obsidian – Traditionally associated with protection, grounding, and inner strength.

• 💛 Pyrite – Symbolizes prosperity, confidence, abundance, and success.

Why You'll Love It

• ✨ Premium 24K Gold-Toned Rice Chain

• 💎 Elegant Pyrite & Black Obsidian Beads

• 💛 Lightweight & Comfortable for Everyday Wear

• 🌟 Premium, Minimal & Versatile Design

• 🎁 Perfect Gift for Birthdays, Anniversaries & Special Occasions

• 💖 Suitable for Men & Women
